chapter_mission: Talon identifies Korda as old GAG security system in respectable clothing. Korda’s presence implies the Foundation is operationally compromised by old GAG-linked security and records access. Talon’s humor thins out — Korda makes Talon feel contaminated by his own past, not merely suspicious. Using Iressa’s tools, Talon submits a fake manifest correction / records query that makes it look as if a missing piece of the Jacen-sealed duplicate manifest has resurfaced. The signal is boring enough to look bureaucratic, but specific enough that anyone guarding the old shipment trail will notice. This is not just hacking. Talon uses the shape of his old compromised work as bait, putting an old version of himself back on the board.
